g.text: v0 — provisional until the ISA spec is frozen at G0 (Oct 11). Boundaries: CLAUDE.md §3
A. One bidirectional protocol pin P[i] (i = 0…7)
2-FF synchronizer: the only place pads are sampled
Reset: PINDIRS = 0, OD_MASK = 0 → uio_oe = 0 (every pin is an input).
Open-drain pin: write 0 → drive low; write 1 → release to the external pull-up. It never drives 1.
IN0–IN4 (ui_in[7:3]) use the same 2-FF sync; OUT0–OUT4 (uo_out[7:3]) are always driven.
B. Engine pin space and base + count mapping
16-entry logical pin space (read side / write side)
source bits → rotate left by BASE
sync'd pin space → rotate right by IN_BASE
Configured by the host while halted: OUT_BASE/OUT_CNT, SET_BASE/SET_CNT, IN_BASE, JMP_PIN, OD_MASK (see diagram 03).
